title: Cube Trainer redesign
question: Choose a direction for the whole app. Solve leads; the cube and timer stay central. These are planning sketches, not the finished design.

options.label: Competition Stage
options.thesis: A centered practice canvas with clear color and a continuous phase ribbon.
options.viewport: Compact navigation and session controls frame a centered cube and timer; recent results sit in one shallow row below analysis.
options.risk: The indigo shell must stay quiet enough that cube stickers and state messages remain distinct.

raised.raise: Stable numeric columns; only changed values update.
Every metric opens its supporting detail nearby.
One content plane; no nested containers.
Meaningful color roles stay consistent across screens.

options.label: Competition Program
options.thesis: A bright, spacious practice screen with cobalt structure and crisp results.
options.viewport: Top navigation, centered cube and timer, a compact phase strip, and a quiet history list at the edge.
options.risk: Familiar and effective; this is closer to a conventional training app.

options.label: Phase Lines
options.thesis: A midnight practice screen whose colored phase ribbon leads directly into analysis.
options.viewport: Standard navigation and session picker lead to the centered cube/timer; a color-coded phase strip selects details below.
options.risk: Phase colors can compete with cube stickers if overused.
options.case: Competitive on clarity: the continuous sequence makes phase selection easy.

options.label: Clear Route
options.thesis: A light practice screen that makes the current setup move unmistakable.
options.viewport: Standard top navigation, centered cube/timer, one emphasized current move in the setup sequence, and analysis below.
options.risk: Route symbolism must remain subordinate to normal cube notation.
options.case: Competitive on identification: different optimal routes remain equally valid.

options.label: Split-flap Concourse
options.thesis: Fixed result rows with live value changes.
options.risk: Character motion distracts from the live solve.
options.kept: Stable numeric columns and selective updates.
options.viewport: Normal practice shell, centered cube and timer, with the source reduced to type, color, density, and one move.
options.case: Declined: weaker audience identification and product clarity than Competition Stage.

options.label: Monochrome Product Proof
options.thesis: Each result is paired with the evidence behind it.
options.risk: Too little color repeats the current complaint.
options.kept: Metrics and their evidence stay close.
options.viewport: Normal practice shell, centered cube and timer, with the source reduced to type, color, density, and one move.
options.case: Declined: weaker audience identification and product clarity than Competition Stage.

options.label: Tabbed Reference Manual
options.thesis: Practice and settings separate into clear sections.
options.risk: Layered sheets would repeat the nested-box problem.
options.viewport: Normal practice shell, centered cube and timer, with the source reduced to type, color, density, and one move.
options.case: Declined: weaker audience identification and product clarity than Competition Stage.

options.label: Character Catalog
options.thesis: Consistent colors distinguish related case information.
options.risk: Mascot and roster emphasis distracts from practice.
options.viewport: Normal practice shell, centered cube and timer, with the source reduced to type, color, density, and one move.
options.case: Declined: weaker audience identification and product clarity than Competition Stage.

canonCard.label: Category Standard
canonCard.thesis: A conventional timer app with careful spacing and clear, restrained color.
canonCard.viewport: Top tabs, a centered cube/timer, compact controls, and a flat history table.
